# Source provenance

- Colab-yoga, Apache-2.0, c29b186e11ed4a9df92ad5b3631b4560f6cb615a. Allocation/readiness/heartbeat lifecycle logic adapted into the Go desktop controller; upstream Apache-2.0 attribution retained in NOTICE. https://github.com/incredible404-rgb/Colab-yoga
- colab-gpu-llm-service, MIT, 32915c0d059f53f635a2f9fc737cf58c23104314. Model manifests, pinned llama.cpp CUDA deployment and `scripts/parallel_download.py` 64 MiB range/thread-pool strategy adapted into `server/download.py` (with cancellation, bounded retries and durable resume metadata). https://github.com/incredible404-rgb/colab-gpu-llm-service

Unsafe runtime source-string runners, local MCP forwarding, implicit model deletion and notebook workflows are not shipped.

- Google Colab CLI, Apache-2.0, version 0.7.5. Public OAuth scopes (`colaboratory` + `drive.file`) and refresh-token lifecycle reused in the Go desktop OAuth controller to generate headless rclone Drive credentials without per-instance browser prompts. https://github.com/googlecolab/google-colab-cli
- EasyColab (wy51ai/easycolab), Apache-2.0. Headless `rclone` `drive.file` mount and direct-API fallback pattern adapted into the Go desktop Drive controller (`[colabone_gdrive]`) and remote `server/drive.py` (`ColabOne_Drive`). https://github.com/wy51ai/easycolab

- ComfyUI, GPL-3.0, v0.46.0 (a277b5bf213e8a44fa34817b7770b54f86ef4cea). Remote-only workflow engine fetched on the Colab GPU runtime and accessed over loopback HTTP/WebSocket API and an authenticated canvas proxy. https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
- LocModel public UI, https://locmodel.com/, consulted for model/run/creative interaction patterns. No private source, brand assets or proprietary code copied.

- luolongfei/Colab, private repository, a1ecb49d9a51fa12b867e56312aebc107a70b28a. Inspected at the owner's request for API-key controls, Quick/named Cloudflare workflows, token-paste parsing and public readiness checks. ColabOne implements its own separate, mandatory-auth inference gateway; no source, packaged binaries, credentials, notebooks or model weights from this repository are redistributed. https://github.com/luolongfei/Colab
- cloudflared, Apache-2.0, release 2026.11.0. Remote-only connector downloaded from official release assets with pinned SHA-256. https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/tag/2026.11.0
- llama.cpp, MIT, release b12032, Copyright (c) 2023-present The ggml authors. Remote-only CUDA 12.8 Ubuntu x64 inference engine and CUDA runtime archives downloaded from official release assets with pinned SHA-256 in `catalog/engine.json`. https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b12032
- rclone, MIT, release v1.76.0. Remote-only Google Drive mount/sync utility downloaded from official release assets with pinned SHA-256. https://github.com/rclone/rclone/releases/tag/v1.76.0
- Remote Colab service Python dependencies (`server/requirements.in` / `server/requirements.txt`, installed with SHA-256 verification only on the remote Colab runtime):
  - `fastapi`, MIT, version 0.165.0, Copyright (c) 2018 Sebastián Ramírez. ASGI web framework powering the remote Colab control API. https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi
  - `uvicorn`, BSD-3-Clause, version 0.54.0, Copyright (c) 2017-present, Encode OSS Ltd. ASGI server running the remote Colab control service. https://github.com/Kludex/uvicorn
  - `requests`, Apache-2.0, version 2.34.2, Copyright 2019 Kenneth Reitz. Synchronous HTTP client used for remote range downloads and upstream probes. https://github.com/psf/requests
  - `pydantic`, MIT, version 2.14.4, Copyright (c) 2017 to present Pydantic Services Inc. and individual contributors. Request and catalog schema validation on the remote Colab runtime. https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic
  - `httpx`, BSD-3-Clause, version 0.28.1, Copyright (c) 2019, Encode OSS Ltd. Async HTTP client used by the remote Colab control service and ComfyUI proxy. https://github.com/encode/httpx
  - `Pillow`, MIT-CMU, version 13.0.0, Copyright (c) 2010 by Jeffrey 'Alex' Clark and contributors (with PIL portions Copyright (c) 1997-2011 by Secret Labs AB and Copyright (c) 1995-2011 by Fredrik Lundh and contributors). Image validation and preview handling on the remote Colab runtime. https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow
- Vue (`vue`), MIT, version 3.5.46, Copyright (c) 2018-present, Yuxi (Evan) You. Reactive component runtime bundled into the embedded desktop WebView frontend. https://github.com/vuejs/core
- Ant Design Vue (`ant-design-vue`), MIT, version 4.2.6, Copyright (c) 2017-present ant-design-vue (with portions Copyright (c) 2015-present Alipay.com and Copyright (c) 2019-present Anthony Fu). Desktop UI component library bundled into the embedded frontend. https://github.com/vueComponent/ant-design-vue
- Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/vue`), MIT, version 2.2.1, Copyright (c) 2020 Phosphor Icons. Vector UI icon components bundled into the desktop frontend. https://github.com/phosphor-icons/vue
- Sarasa Gothic (Sarasa UI SC), SIL OFL 1.1, release v1.0.43 (`SarasaUiSC-TTF-1.0.43.7z`, SHA-256 `3dc0f534b2cfa5f98b58a574948d3e3f9eb140600bd738f259c3d077acb2de66`). Hinted Simplified Chinese + Latin/UI WOFF2 subsets (`Regular`, `SemiBold`, `Bold`) built reproducibly via `tools/build_fonts.py` into `frontend/src/assets/fonts/` and distributed under `third_party/sarasa-gothic.LICENSE`. https://github.com/be5invis/Sarasa-Gothic/releases/tag/v1.0.43
- flag-icons, MIT, version 7.6.0, Copyright (c) 2013 Panayiotis Lipiridis. Ready-made 4:3 SVG country/region flags (`cn`, `us`, `tw`, `hk`, `jp`, `kr`) bundled offline in the desktop language switcher. https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons
- Shiki (`@shikijs/core`, `@shikijs/engine-javascript`, `@shikijs/langs`, `@shikijs/themes`), MIT, version 4.6.0, Copyright (c) 2021 Pine Wu and Copyright (c) 2023 Anthony Fu. Selective TextMate grammars (`shellscript`, `python`, `toml`, `json`) and theme (`one-dark-pro`) bundled offline with the pure JavaScript regex engine for desktop dark-surface code block syntax highlighting. https://github.com/shikijs/shiki
- MyGo (`github.com/egoist/mygo` v0.10.0 and `mygo-runtime` 0.10.0), MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MyGo contributors. Native Go desktop shell, WebView host, frontend runtime bridge, typed IPC bindings, system tray, and single-binary packaging framework. https://github.com/egoist/mygo
- coder/websocket (`github.com/coder/websocket`), ISC, version v1.8.15, Copyright (c) 2025 Coder. Pure Go WebSocket client powering authenticated Jupyter kernel RPC connections from the desktop controller to remote Colab runtimes. https://github.com/coder/websocket
